files.purpose: New module. Thin dispatcher (sync, single try/catch per sink) for the normalized request-completion contract. Accepts one immutable RequestContext and routes it to MetricsAggregators, RequestHistory, MetricsStore, and AnalyticsEngine through injected accessor callbacks; optional recordError method documented for Task 4 wiring. Never a state owner; never persists a second copy.
lines_observed: recordRequest: 4 sink invocations (metricsAggregators, requestHistory, metricsStore, analyticsEngine) each in its own try/catch
recordError: stub for Task 4 (returns early when no error store wired)

covers: exposes a recordRequest method on the class (covers constructor + class shape)
invokes all five sinks exactly once per recordRequest call (covers the success hot path with all five sinks)
isolates a throwing metricsAggregators sink from the rest of the dispatch (covers the metricsAggregators try/catch)
isolates a throwing requestHistory sink from the rest of the dispatch (covers the requestHistory try/catch)
isolates a throwing metricsStore sink from the rest of the dispatch (covers the metricsStore try/catch)
isolates a throwing analyticsEngine sink from the rest of the dispatch (covers the analyticsEngine try/catch)
propagates the malformed-context failure as a domain error (covers the boundary swallows sink errors)
dispatches a structured error event when the context is a failure (covers the success-path branch)
does NOT invoke ErrorEventStore.recordError on the success hot path (covers the recordRequest short-circuit)
propagates the decisionId field to all sinks (covers the field passthrough)
